# Loading

What to show while PLUS fetches or saves something. Two inputs decide it: what is loading, and how long it has taken. The bands are 1 s and 10 s.

**Kind:** Pattern

**Storybook page:** `design-system/src/storybook-docs/patterns/Loading/Loading.mdx`

## By what is loading

Four kinds of wait. Each has its own shape in the 1 to 10 s band; the time bands are the same for all.

- **A list or cards.** A skeleton in the real shape, so the layout stays still.
- **A button action.** A spinner inside the button that started it. The fields stay as they are.
- **A whole page.** The Frame and page header draw first; each Section fills as its data arrives.
- **A menu.** One "Loading options" row, never a skeleton. Fetch items before the click where you can.

## Usage

Use Loading whenever the product is fetching or saving and the person is waiting. Decide by two inputs: what is loading, and how long it has taken. The rule is the same whatever the page.

| What is loading | Under 1 s | 1 to 10 s | Over 10 s |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| A list or cards | Keep what was there; blank on first load | A skeleton in the real shape, `aria-busy`, "Loading students…" announced | The skeleton stays; a Flag explains the wait |
| A button action | Nothing yet; the button blocks a second press | A spinner inside the button; fields stay as they are | A Flag says it is still working and the person can leave; a Flag confirms when done |
| A whole page | Keep the previous page; blank screens wait | Frame and page header now, a skeleton in each Section | A labeled progress bar for a long job |
| A menu, Popup, Flag or Modal | Open complete; fetch before the click | One "Loading options" row; no skeleton | "Couldn't load options" with Retry, still one row |

## Alternatives

- For a wait whose length is known, use `ProgressBar`; it answers "how much longer".
- For a view that turns out to have nothing, follow Empty.
- For a load that failed, follow the Errors pattern: the error goes in the empty-state slot with Try again.

## Content guidelines

| Do | Don't |
| --- | --- |
| Announce what is loading: "Loading students…", then "Students loaded". | "Loading…" as the only text on a page. |
| Flag past 10 s: "Still loading students. This group is large; you can keep working." | "Please wait", "Hang tight!". |
| Progress bar label: "Importing roster · 40 of 120 students". | A bar with no words. |
| Menu rows: "Loading options" · "Couldn't load options" with "Retry". | "Error", "Failed to fetch". |

## Accessibility

- Every skeleton is `aria-hidden`, never takes focus and ignores the pointer.
- The busy region's live label sits beside the region, not inside it, because content inside a busy region may be held back.
- A spinner announces as a status with a label that says what is loading when it is not obvious.
- Reduced motion: the shimmer stops and the spinner becomes a static ring; the shape still reads as working.

## Parts

| Part | Component | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Placeholder | Skeleton | Text bars in the content's own shape; `isShimmering` holds still under reduced motion. |
| Spinner | Spinner | Inside a Button through `isLoading`; the button keeps its width. |
| Long job | Progress bar | A value and a label that says what is happening. |
| Wait explained | Flag | Information appearance, held until the work finishes. |
| Menu rows | Dropdown menu | `loading` shows "Loading options"; `hasError` with `onRetry` shows "Couldn't load options". |

## Related

- Empty: use once the load finishes with nothing.
- Errors: use when the load fails.
- Notifications: use for the Flag past 10 s.

## Best practices

### Show nothing new under 1 s. {#show-nothing-new-under-1-s}

**Checked:** Review

Keep the old content, or leave the area blank on a first load. A skeleton or spinner that appears and vanishes reads as a glitch rather than work. A button blocks a second press at once.

### Draw a skeleton in the real shape from 1 s. {#draw-a-skeleton-in-the-real-shape-from-1-s}

**Checked:** Review

The same rows, columns and cards the content will have, as plain text bars, so nothing jumps when it arrives. The container owns the skeleton; labels become text bars rather than label shapes. The shimmer stays on while loading.

Do: A skeleton in the table's own shape, text bars throughout.
Don't: One spinner in a blank area: the layout jumps when the rows arrive.

### Put the spinner inside the button that started the action. {#put-the-spinner-inside-the-button-that-started-the-action}

**Checked:** Automatic

The label swaps for a spinner in place and the button keeps its width. Only that button disables; the fields and Cancel stay live. One spinner per wait.

### Draw the Frame and page header first. {#draw-the-frame-and-page-header-first}

**Checked:** Review

On a quick move keep the previous page until the next is ready. Past 1 s the Frame, Sidebar and page header draw at once and each Section fills as its data arrives. A full-screen blocking overlay has no place in a wait.

### Say so after 10 s. {#say-so-after-10-s}

**Checked:** Review

A Flag explains the wait and that the person can keep working or leave; a Flag confirms when the work finishes. A long job with a known length, such as importing a roster, gets a labeled progress bar instead.

### Keep a menu, Popup, Flag or Modal free of skeletons. {#keep-a-menu-popup-flag-or-modal-free-of-skeletons}

**Checked:** Review

They open in answer to a click and open complete. A menu whose items must load shows one "Loading options" row, then "Couldn't load options" with Retry. A Modal's body may hold its content's own loading state.

Do: A menu shows one &quot;Loading options&quot; row.
Don't: A menu full of skeleton rows, promising items it may not have.

### Mark the loading region busy and announce it. {#mark-the-loading-region-busy-and-announce-it}

**Checked:** Review

`aria-busy` on the container that is loading, and a visually hidden status beside it whose text is set after mount: "Loading students…", then "Students loaded". Skeletons themselves are hidden from assistive technology.
